description: This Java class 'DefaultMapperLimitsConfig' implements configuration for mapper limits, including maximum counts for source mappers, inbound messages, target mappers, and outbound messages, with methods for instantiation, equality, and string representation.

classes.name: DefaultMapperLimitsConfig
classes.description: Implementation of MapperLimitsConfig that holds configuration limits for mappers and messages.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates an instance of DefaultMapperLimitsConfig from a Config object, applying fallback logic.

methods.name: getMaxSourceMappers
methods.description: Returns the maximum number of source mappers allowed.

methods.name: getMaxMappedInboundMessages
methods.description: Returns the maximum number of inbound messages that can be mapped.

methods.name: getMaxTargetMappers
methods.description: Returns the maximum number of target mappers allowed.

methods.name: getMaxMappedOutboundMessages
methods.description: Returns the maximum number of outbound messages that can be mapped.
